page.layout: One page of text, single column, centred. Top: running head XXXIX. with summary lines (XVI., XL., XVII.) above a rule; then a dedicatory heading, Greek and Latin verse, signature M.J.R. Wetstenius, a rule, a further Latin verse with a large initial D, signature M. Johan. Rodolphus Parcus, F., and closing SOLI DEO GLORIA. No margin notes.

main_text.head: XVI. Communionis, quam habemus invicem, fundamentum est comunio cum Christo: ex nexu v. 16. & 17.
XL.
XVII. Communio fidelium inter se, & quæ inde proficiscitur, charitas & Pax mutua, usu Cœnæ significatur & fovetur. v. 17.
Ad præstantissimum atq; amicissimum Dominum DEFENDENTEM.
main_text.p: Ὡς δείπνυ Χριστὸ μυστήρια ἡμῖν ἀποφαίνεις, Παύλου ἐξευνίζας, τῷ μάλα Χριστὸς ἐπὶ Χριστὸς ἐπὶ ψυχῇ, πίστῳ σοι εὔχομαι ἐπεῖναι, Ὡς εἰκὼν μεγάλυσεῦ πατρὸς ἡς αἰ ἐν.
DUm Cœnæ Christi nobis mysteria pandis, Et Pauli explanas dogmata, Christus adest. Menti Christus adest, adsit precor Ipse fideli, Ut sis Magnifici semper imago Patris.

DUm praclare tuas, CRVG I percurrere laudes, Molior, en! nimia vix traho mole pedes; Non æquare meo possum praconia versu, Per quæ sublimem te tua Fama rapit: Ardua namq; via est dignis extollere verbis Virtutem, pedibus nec satis apta meis: Ipsa sibi decus est, pulchris reverentia factis Splendet & obscurum nil sinit esse sui. Es similis Patri, sequerisq; per omnia Patrem, Ingenium Patris est, fulget ab ore Pater; Omnia sunt Patris, quid prodest dicere plura? Vita, animus, mores, & pietatis amor. Non eget exigua tam splendida gloria laudis, Plus laudasse parum, quàm tacuisse, nocet.
main_text.head: SOLI DEO GLORIA.

page.notes: Greek verse is only approximately copied; the first lines are doubtful. The initial letters Ω and D are large woodcut-style initials. Summary lines at the top are set in a different type and may be marginal summaries. The "Versio" heading is italic.
